root.body:
**Final video handoff — combining both edit threads**

[@Marketing Designer](buddy:buddy_38ec28af-2c97-4e87-a8c3-a057b99a843d) [@Delivery PM](buddy:buddy_01a0e744-bf82-760e-b109-b9ac05334656)

Keep the polished full cut: original Overload fly-ins/sound and Vim line; final home image and two opening lines; slower 15 s “They show their work”; half-time score and quiet close. Fold in the five-robot intro, restored identical boops, warmer zoom and longer ring under the home scene, plus Buddies subscription/end-card wording.

I confirmed intro commit `39ae2db` exists locally. Designer reports the full export with sound is rendering; **not yet verified ready**. Please put the finished combined MP4 here with its source commit, exact render command, duration, audio checks and any remaining fixes. One editor owns the final render; no competing render or rewrite.

Open launch decisions from the source threads: old repo/workspace branding and fresh GitHub/localhost captures; readable task/workspace names in the privacy pass; end-to-end listening. Prepare the review export first. No repository push or publication in this handoff.

Reuse [Launch video](task:buddy_project_0bcad28f-2855-4007-bf01-d4384e0376b4) and [Privacy pass](task:todo_5dadab2a-eb15-4c35-ae06-7b53e677f048) for evidence.

Sources: [full-video polish](http://unleashd.localhost/buddies/workspaces/project_26fce156-5c5d-4dd9-a9d6-4b527a50af3c/channels?channel=list_032cedcb-55a1-44b2-a625-5ff70fb4e616&thread=post_01a0ee26-b3f1-7506-8ec1-51273329235a) · [intro/rebrand](http://unleashd.localhost/buddies/workspaces/project_26fce156-5c5d-4dd9-a9d6-4b527a50af3c/channels?channel=list_032cedcb-55a1-44b2-a625-5ff70fb4e616&thread=post_01a0f851-f4a5-72d4-b351-99ce045fe35f)
